# PlayTechCorner

> PlayTechCorner publishes fan-made player tools. Crazy Dragon is a MIR4 clan manager. PumpMap PH is a Philippines gas-station and EV-charger map, and it is in development. Crazy Dragon Web is an unofficial companion with boss timers, a checklist, and clan tools.

This is an unofficial fan site, not affiliated with Wemade. MIR4 is a trademark of Wemade. Crazy Dragon Web does not scrape the game and does not use Wemade art. Boss timers are schedule estimates. Checklist ticks, planner notes, and clan records stay in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://playtechcorner.com/): PlayTechCorner apps, including Crazy Dragon and PumpMap PH.
- [Crazy Dragon](https://playtechcorner.com/crazy-dragon/): Fan-made MIR4 clan app for donations, members, and expeditions.
- [Crazy Dragon web app](https://playtechcorner.com/app/): The clan tools in the browser. Data stays in the browser and does not sync with the phone app.
- [PumpMap PH](https://playtechcorner.com/pumpmap/): Map of gas stations and EV chargers in the Philippines. In development, with a closed test.
- [Support](https://playtechcorner.com/support/): Email contact for PlayTechCorner.
- [Crazy Dragon Web](https://playtechcorner.com/mir4/): Unofficial companion with a 53-boss schedule, daily checklist, expedition calculator, character compare, and a clan board stored in the browser.
